title: CSV export times out on workspaces over 50,000 tasks
author: globex-ops
body: Since Monday our weekly CSV export fails with a 504 after 30 seconds. Our workspace has 61,000 tasks and our finance team needs this file every Friday.

title: Stream CSV rows instead of building the export file in memory
author: dana-data
body: Merged in #401. Memory use is fine now, but a large export still runs inside one web request, so it hits the load balancer's 30 second limit.

title: Dark mode for the task list
author: lee-web
